fields.description:
## Problem (parity sibling of the tickets-branch invariant violation)
Two more tickets-branch writers bypass the shared store seams and the two-part invariant
(under the unified write lock + auto-commit/publish), same class as projects_store
(ticket fea4-f98c-f1a2-4168, LANDED):
1. reconcile_helpers._commit_binding_store_snapshot (reconcile_helpers.py:169) commits
   .bridge_state binding/rotation/link state via raw git_adapter.add + commit. git_adapter
   imports only rebar._store.gitutil.run_git — it does NOT acquire rebar._store.lock.write_lock,
   so it races the ticket-CLI _push_tickets_branch() and concurrent GHA commit-back (the
   exact race the write lock exists to prevent).
2. alert_store._atomic_write (alert_store.py:84) hand-rolls tempfile+os.replace instead of
   the shared rebar._store.fsutil.atomic_write seam.

## Use the EXISTING seams (NO new facade, NO redesign) — same as ticket fea4
- rebar._store.push.commit_and_push_tickets_branch(tracker, *, message=...) — stages ALL
  pending tracker changes with `git add -A`, commits them under the unified write lock
  (+ rebase guard), then pushes. This mirrors the GHA commit-back step and is exactly the
  seam fea4 adopted for projects_store.
- rebar._store.fsutil.atomic_write — the shared crash-atomic write.

## Approach
### 1. _commit_binding_store_snapshot -> commit_and_push_tickets_branch (INTENTIONAL widening)
Replace the raw git_adapter add/commit (and the selective 5-file staging + per-file
idempotency logic it currently hand-rolls: bindings.json, bindings-retired.json,
get_rotation.json, impossible_links.json, peer_confirmations.json) with a single call to
push.commit_and_push_tickets_branch(tracker_dir, message=..., strict=True) INSIDE the
existing try/except.
- This is NOT a claim of committed-file-set equivalence. The seam stages `git add -A`, so it
  commits ALL pending changes in the .tickets-tracker worktree under the lock, which is a
  deliberate WIDENING from the prior selective staging and the intended parity behavior
  (identical to GHA commit-back and to the landed fea4 conversion of projects_store).
- Why the widening is safe / behavior-preserving in substance: the reconciler's
  .tickets-tracker worktree only ever holds tickets-branch state — ticket events are already
  auto-committed by the store, so the only files that can be pending here are .bridge_state
  artifacts that BELONG on the tickets branch anyway (binding stores, get_rotation,
  impossible_links, peer_confirmations, projects.json, prev_snapshot, last-pass). `git add -A`
  therefore never commits a file that should not be on the tickets branch; at worst it lands
  an already-tickets-branch file (e.g. a rare pending operator projects.json write) in the
  same locked commit instead of a later one. This widening is PINNED by a test (see Testing),
  not asserted away.
- Fail-open PRESERVED: strict=True raises PushDeliveryError on any local/commit/push failure;
  the existing except catches it, logs the same stderr line, appends the same
  binding-commit-failure alert, and returns False — the pass never aborts. On success return
  True. On a clean tree the seam performs NO commit, but — unlike today's early-return —
  it still calls push_tickets_branch (the seam always ensures delivery after the locked
  phase, since a clean tracker can be ahead of its remote). This added clean-tree push is a
  deliberate consequence of adopting the unified commit+push seam; it stays fail-open (a
  push failure under strict=True raises -> except -> False + alert, same posture as a commit
  failure). A retirement-only change makes the tree dirty, so it still commits (bug 1e08
  outcome preserved).

### 2. alert_store._atomic_write -> fsutil.atomic_write (RESIDENCY = LOCAL SCRATCH)
alert_store writes to repo_root/bridge_state/bridge_alerts (NO dot), which .gitignore
('bridge_state/') ignores and which is NOT tracked on the tickets branch (only the dotted
.bridge_state/* is). So the alert files are local scratch: fsutil.atomic_write ALONE is
correct — NO publish/commit path is added.
- IMPORTANT: current _atomic_write does parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True) before
  writing; fsutil.atomic_write does NOT create the destination directory. So KEEP an explicit
  path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True) immediately before the fsutil.atomic_write
  call, then call fsutil.atomic_write(path, content, permissions=0o600, fsync=True) to
  preserve exact serialized bytes, mode 0o600 (mkstemp default, no chmod today), and the
  fsync-before-replace durability.

## Constraints — BEHAVIOR-PRESERVING
No functional change beyond lock+seam adoption: same fail-open on commit error, same
no-op-when-clean, same on-disk alert bytes/mode. Reuse existing seams ONLY; add no helper.

## Testing / Verification
- RED-first. _commit_binding_store_snapshot: patch push.commit_and_push_tickets_branch (NOT
  subprocess) and assert (a) it is invoked with the tracker_dir and strict=True; (b) a raised
  PushDeliveryError yields fail-open (returns False, pass not aborted, binding-commit-failure
  alert appended); (c) success returns True; (d) the INTENDED widening is pinned — when an
  unrelated pending .bridge_state file (e.g. projects.json) exists, it is included in the
  single locked commit (documents that git add -A commits all pending tickets-branch state).
- alert_store: byte-identity test that fsutil.atomic_write produces the same file contents and
  0o600 mode as before, and that the write succeeds when the parent dir does not pre-exist
  (guards the retained mkdir).
- Re-point existing tests coupled to the removed selective-staging mechanism at the seam:
  tests/unit/rebar_reconciler/state/test_commit_binding_store_failure.py,
  test_binding_retired_commit.py, test_get_rotation_commit_heldout.py,
  test_binding_commit_survives_merge.py, test_git_adapter_characterization.py, AND
  tests/unit/rebar_reconciler/apply/test_peer_confirmations_store.py,
  test_impossible_links_cicada.py.
- Proving commands (all must pass): `make lint`; `make typecheck`;
  `python -m pytest tests/unit/rebar_reconciler/ -q` (modulo the known-unrelated
  state/test_ref_lock.py::test_ac0_blob_ref_roundtrips_through_remote flake).

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] _commit_binding_store_snapshot routes through push.commit_and_push_tickets_branch
      (tracker_dir, message=..., strict=True); the raw git_adapter add/commit + selective
      staging is removed; fail-open (returns False + appends binding-commit-failure alert on
      PushDeliveryError, pass not aborted) is preserved; a clean tree performs no commit
      (the seam may still push to ensure delivery); pinned by a test that patches the seam.
- [ ] The intended `git add -A` widening is pinned by a test showing an unrelated pending
      .bridge_state file is committed in the same locked commit (no silent non-tickets-branch
      file is ever swept).
- [ ] alert_store._atomic_write is replaced by fsutil.atomic_write with a retained
      parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True); residency determined = local scratch
      (documented); no publish path; exact bytes + 0o600 mode + fsync preserved; pinned by a
      byte-identity test that also covers the missing-parent-dir case.
- [ ] No functional/behavioral change beyond lock+seam adoption.
- [ ] `make lint`, `make typecheck`, and `python -m pytest tests/unit/rebar_reconciler/ -q`
      all pass (modulo the known-unrelated state/test_ref_lock.py flake).

## Sequencing
Depends on fea4 (LANDED). Edits reconcile_helpers.py + alert_store.py (+ tests) — disjoint
from A/C/D.
